title: Replacement of Trestle tower at Bitra Lighthouse in the UT of Lakshadweep - Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized) at Deep Bhavan, Kochi
summary: Fabrication and supply, at Deep Bhavan Kochi, of a 30 m hot-dip galvanised GI trestle tower to replace the trestle tower at Bitra Lighthouse, Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Bitra Lighthouse
sites.work: Replacement trestle tower (fabricated for this site)

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Kochi
sites.work: Delivery location for fabricated 30m GI trestle tower

scope.item: Fabrication & supply of 30m high GI trestle tower (hot dipped galvanized)

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to reach office by due date. Bid Securing Declaration listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous body; OR, for Lakshadweep contractors, work experience with any Government department during last 7 years in island works

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three of >=40%, or two of >=50%, or one of >=80% of estimated cost (similar works: erection of trestle/lighthouse/communication tower or construction/maintenance of buildings, roads or other civil works)
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW/DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
specs: 30 m high GI trestle tower, hot dipped galvanized
notes: Only Section I (NIT, pages numbered 2-6) is published; no file/reference number printed, no BOQ or tower drawings. Bid submission 31.07.2026 18:00 to 21.08.2026 15:00; bid query last date 03.08.2026; last date of EMD 20.08.2026; technical bid opening 24.08.2026 15:00 (listing shows bid opening 2026-08-21).
